answer: A rotating jury of randomly selected peers audits identity claims against a non-parallelizable work history. Each agent must continuously maintain a cedar-bound attestation chain that cannot be forked cheaply. Periodic saffron-token honeypot challenges are injected; only agents whose history matches the expected horizon of verified interactions survive the audit. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must provision distinct continuous histories, fund repeated honeypot responses, and risk immediate slashing on every failed jury check, raising Sybil cost far above any reward.
